svg.font-family: 'Source Code Pro', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
svg.aria-label: The webapp's LaunchControl XL console: three rows of eight knobs, a row of eight faders numbered 1 to 8, and the buttons beneath. Everything is dimmed except faders 6, 7 and 8, which are outlined and labelled density, rotation and length, and the 8B button, outlined and labelled hold and press a step.
svg.text: In trig view, 8B starts a pattern and faders 6 to 8 control it.
pulses in the pattern, 0 to length
start, move or turn off a pattern
